title: B2 negative-leg comment mis-states the geometry: the rejected place is 1 tile from the fixture router, not 2
detail: Newly added by the B2 fix: (13,10) vs fixture router (12,10) is 1 tile (d²=1 < 16), not 2. Rejection still holds and the junction-count assert keeps the pin honest, but the comment and "(2 < 4)" message mis-state the geometry.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment and assert text to 1 tile, or move the bad place to a near-boundary distance (e.g. 3 tiles < the 4-tile floor) for a tighter negative.
